source: User-supplied reviews and follow-up discussion, not independent production audit

findings.finding: Governance capture and reverse doc drift
findings.response: Trusted-base gate, protected policy, detached owner signatures and explicit bootstrap

findings.finding: Code/doc edits in one commit must always fail
findings.response: Allow coherent changes with exact protected promotion and impact evidence. No arbitrary diff-size proxy.

findings.finding: Index all file classes and fix skill frontmatter
findings.response: All managed files indexed with metadata checks, explicit self-hash exclusions and valid skill metadata

findings.finding: Keep only AGENTS invariants at runtime
findings.response: Runtime has no automatic AGENTS access. Invariant registry supplies generated runtime text.

findings.finding: Model ActionIntent needs ownerId and approvalId
findings.response: Those are server-derived ProposedAction and ExecutionAuthorization fields, never model authority

findings.finding: Executor manifest missing operational safety fields
findings.response: Separate capability and executor contracts include idempotency, expiry, credentials, verification and reconciliation

findings.finding: Life Ledger replay safety
findings.response: Versioned owner/source derivation keys and revision fields

findings.finding: Unbounded standing leases
findings.response: Finite typed proposals, fresh grants/renewals, no high-impact leases, shorter Night Mode cap

findings.finding: Default every new capability to a lease
findings.response: New capability is denied until registration, review and applicable explicit authority. No auto-broadening under approval fatigue.

findings.finding: Approval latency proves inattention
findings.response: Use bounded telemetry as a review signal, not a diagnosis or automatic authority change

findings.finding: Dedicated first-party approval surface
findings.response: Canonical payload display and fresh step-up, messaging only notifies for high-impact approval

findings.finding: Fixed midnight-to-six ban
findings.response: Use actual owner sleep state and conscious step-up. Night Mode never creates or executes high-impact authority.

findings.finding: Budget $60 is already approved
findings.response: Earlier assistant proposal is not consent. Proposed $50 historical-context profile remains disabled.

findings.finding: No cost guard exists
findings.response: Existing source has ModelBudgetGuard. Preserve it, add durable reservations/concurrency and loop gates.

findings.finding: Brain evaluations are absent from CI
findings.response: Observed CI explicitly invokes brain:evals plus other evaluation suites. Preserve and extend.

findings.finding: A permanently green eval suite is dead
findings.response: Regression suites should stay green. Audit incident coverage, withheld judgment cases and fixture weakening.

findings.finding: Nine kill switches already work
findings.response: Generic source flag is not nine independent deployed controls. Actual drill evidence remains required.

findings.finding: Let JARVIS certify its own stop drills
findings.response: External runner and synthetic test account, plus real local/cloud enforcement paths

findings.finding: Every substantial session needs location for handoff
findings.response: Mutable canonical working state plus append-only meaningful milestone and run receipts

findings.finding: Missions 9/11 and Night Mode missing
findings.response: Twenty stable-ID V4 missions include device policy, workforce, modes, browser and night-mode gates

findings.finding: SchemaVersion 1 inside a V4 folder is necessarily wrong
findings.response: Product generation, contract revision and wire schemaVersion are explicitly separate

findings.finding: ZERO_COST remains active conflicting doctrine
findings.response: Original V3 file was historical. V4 retains historical status and active cost-policy pointer.

findings.finding: Rewrite accepted ADRs to fit template
findings.response: Preserve actual repository history. V4 proposals follow complete template before acceptance.

findings.finding: Enable all provider MCPs by default
findings.response: Explicit read authorization and documented verification procedure, not blanket production access

findings.finding: Rename KAREN everywhere
findings.response: Internal mentor identifier, optional owner-facing KAREN label, no behavior or authority escalation

findings.finding: Prompt version is entirely absent
findings.response: Source stores versions. New assembly preview adds exact content digests without pretending runtime loader migrated.

findings.finding: Machine config snapshots belong in blind overlay
findings.response: No root package/lock/workspace/compose/env replacements. Optional reviewed integration fragments only.

findings.finding: Research summaries lost provenance
findings.response: Twenty separate source-attributed systems with explicit limitations, no silent framework adoption

findings.finding: Owner absence is undefined
findings.response: Mode narrows power, external work waits, no inference of consent from inactivity

findings.finding: Counter checks eliminate unknown side effects
findings.response: Post-dispatch uncertainty persists and reconciles even after cancellation or stop

findings.finding: Mission dependencies need a real admission check
findings.response: Purpose-separated receipts, transitive prerequisite checks, current definition hashes and trusted checkpoint ancestry. No claim of installation.

findings.finding: Governance-key recovery is operationally underspecified
findings.response: Isolated owner command path, public-state transition verifier and dummy-key rotation/recovery/revocation tests. Atomic external installation still required.

findings.finding: Every task should read the complete PRD
findings.response: Rejected full-context loading. Bounded topic packets select exact requirements and relevant skills.

findings.finding: V5 must replace all previous code
findings.response: Explicit keep/repair/migrate/replace/retire/unresolved program with pinned code evidence.

findings.finding: Signed prompt version exists so byte provenance is complete
findings.response: Source inspection shows ID/version-only fingerprint. Preserve persistence and repair content addressing through loader migration.

findings.finding: Context caps cover the complete request
findings.response: Source inspection shows selected-record content estimate. Reconcile final payload measurement and conservative metered admission.

scope: Historical review decisions retained and V5 additions, not independent production audit
